result.coreMessage: I know when my coffee was roasted, where it comes from, and that I can skip a week.
result.hook: Jeg ved, hvornår min kaffe er ristet.
result.visualDirection: Close-up photograph of hands holding a warm ceramic cup over a light wooden kitchen table in soft morning daylight, a plain unmarked coffee bag beside it with no labels, a small plain bowl of coffee beans nearby, calm blurred kitchen background, no faces, no letters, no text, no numbers, no logos visible.
result.headlineDa: Ristet i Aarhus, med dato på posen
result.headlineEn: Roasted in Aarhus, with the date on the bag
result.primaryTextDa: Jeg køber én gang, og næste pose ristes bagefter. Ristedatoen står på posen, og jeg kan springe en uge over. Det er single origin fra Aarhus, så jeg ved, hvad jeg får hver morgen.
result.primaryTextEn: I buy once, and the next bag is roasted after that. The roast date is on the bag, and I can skip a week. It is single origin from Aarhus, so I know what I get every morning.
